text:
Attention: Your Wallet Has been Blocked!
Hi
Attention all crypto holders: Due to the dramatic increase in our platform users, some wallets still need to manually perform the new upgrade. You must upgrade your wallets before […] in order to keep your assets secure and accessible.
Suppose I didn’t upgrade my wallet — what would happen?
You will lose all of your cryptocurrencies if you neglect to update your wallet.
Recover My Wallet Now
notes: Crypto-wallet phishing email. The deadline date is blacked out in the FTC image. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. […] marks text hidden on the page itself (FAKE stamp, blur or an overlay); nothing was filled in.
